name: My electric water heater has no hot water. What should I check first?

mainEntity.name: My electric water heater has no hot water. What should I check first?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your electric water heater isn't providing hot water, the first thing to check is your home's electrical panel. Look for a tripped circuit breaker labeled for the water heater and reset it. If the breaker trips again immediately, there's likely a short circuit or a serious electrical issue, and you should call a professional. Also, ensure the thermostat on the water heater itself is set to an appropriate temperature. Faulty heating elements or thermostats are also common causes, requiring professional diagnosis.
acceptedAnswer.description: First, check and reset the circuit breaker for your water heater in your electrical panel. Also, verify the thermostat setting on the unit.
